description: Check a service reservation against the customer's instruction before the payment. Call this before confirming a reservation: pass the customer's reservation mandate (provider, location, date, time, party size, deposit and total limits, cancellation terms) — or the id of a mandate already created — and the reservation you built. ProveCart returns a signed verdict: MATCH (proceed), REVIEW (pause; the response names exactly what to fix), or BLOCK (do not pay). Every check leaves a sealed evidence record; ProveCart never holds or moves money. Non-MATCH responses follow the Agent Correction Format (ACF): a machine-readable corrections array (dimension, action, expected, actual, reason), a retry budget, and a sealed evidence pointer (spec: https://provecart.com/standards/correction-format). Requires an integrator API key in the X-API-Key header.

mandate.description: The customer's instruction as a mandate object (the shape of the REST mandate endpoint for this kind). Provide either 'mandate' or 'mandate_id'.
mandate.title: ReservationMandateIn

mandate_id.description: The id of a mandate already created through the REST API. Provide either 'mandate' or 'mandate_id'.

reservation.description: The reservation the agent built: provider, location, date, time, party size, name, deposit, total, cancellation (the shape of POST /verify-reservation, without mandate_id).
reservation.title: ReservationVerifyIn

name: provecart_check_reservation
title: ProveCart: check a reservation before payment
